title: Wire the supplied favicon assets into Next.js
context: Use Next.js App Router file conventions to expose the supplied custom favicon assets without adding manual head tags or PWA behavior.

tasks.title: Rename favicon assets to Next.js file conventions
acceptance_criteria: The supplied SVG is available as src/app/icon.svg and the supplied 180px PNG is available as src/app/apple-icon.png.
The supplied multi-size src/app/favicon.ico remains available as the browser fallback.
Next.js generates favicon links for icon.svg and favicon.ico plus an Apple touch icon link for apple-icon.png without manual layout head tags or a manifest.
The generated icon URLs and the /favicon.ico fallback return successful responses in the browser test.
